item.title: Open Source PcapAnalyzer Ships 27 Network Fault Detectors
item.description:
PcapAnalyzer is an Apache 2.0 open-source, self-hosted analyzer for .pcap/.pcapng captures that runs 27 detectors covering TCP retransmissions and window anomalies, PMTUD black holes, DNS/DHCP/ARP failures, TLS alerts, and tunnels such as IPsec, WireGuard and OpenVPN, each finding paired with a severity and next-step guidance. Captures stay on local infrastructure, making it relevant for security-sensitive network operations; the project is currently in beta.

原文标题：PcapAnalyzer 开源 27 项网络故障检测器

Why it matters：面向网络排障的开源本地抓包分析工具，检测器覆盖面广且给出可执行排查建议，对运维与 SRE 读者有直接实用价值。

item.title: Frontier Models Can Identify Anonymous Authors From Writing Style Alone
item.description:
A new University of Maryland paper finds that frontier models, given only a single text and a zero-shot prompt with no tools or candidate lists, detect AI-written prose as well as trained detectors like Pangram while explaining their reasoning. More strikingly, they infer authorship: Claude Fable 5.2 identified the reviewer in 56% of 398 anonymous peer reviews and the account behind 69% of comments from Redditors with over 500 posts a year. The anonymity assumptions behind blind review and pseudonymous forums are now weak.

原文标题：马里兰大学研究：前沿模型可凭文风识别匿名作者

Why it matters：该研究把文风指纹识别推到前沿模型的原生能力层面，直接冲击匿名评审与化名社区的隐私假设。

item.title: Signal Restricts Mobile Screenshots to Counter AI Agent Surveillance
item.description:
Signal announced it is restricting in-app screenshots on Android and iOS by default, following a similar move on Windows. President Meredith Whittaker called operating systems with integrated AI agents an existential threat, arguing their screen-scanning capabilities prevent Signal from independently guaranteeing privacy. She acknowledged the fix is incomplete and can be disabled by users, which would break the app's privacy guarantees.

原文标题：Signal 限制移动端截图以应对 AI 代理监控威胁

Why it matters：端到端加密通讯应用首次因操作系统级 AI 代理的屏幕读取能力而收紧截图权限，折射出 AI 代理与隐私边界的结构性冲突。

item.title: Eric Schmidt Says a Mutual AI Race Pause Is Impossible
item.description:
Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt argues in an Economist interview that a mutual pause in the US-China AI race is unworkable, since either side has incentives to cheat and UN-style verification is technically infeasible. Modern codebases are largely machine-written, he notes, so no human inspection team can review them line by line, and inspectors cannot access secret facilities including military labs.

item.title: Claude Autonomously Finds Algorithm Breaking 3SUM and APSP Limits
item.description:
A new Columbia and MIT paper reports that Claude autonomously discovered a faster method for computing selected entries of a product of two long, thin matrices, which classic reductions turn into speedups for 3SUM and all-pairs shortest paths. 3SUM now runs in O(n^1.9992) and APSP in O(n^2.9995, tiny gains that nonetheless refute the long-standing 3SUM and APSP hypotheses. The method was found in a single AI session using 16M output tokens with no human input and was formally checked in Lean 4.

原文标题：Claude 自主发现算法突破 3SUM 与全源最短路极限

Why it matters：AI 首次自主推翻长期算法复杂度猜想，是 AI for Science 与算法研究的标志性节点。

item.title: Open Source Quantization Compiler Shrinks Qwen3.5-4B to 1.2 GB
item.description:
The open source LookAtMyQuant project introduces a post-training quantization compiler that allocates bit budgets per stored unit based on measured output damage, using Fisher information and trellis codes. Its second version compresses Qwen3.5-4B to 1.23 GB (~2.3 bits per weight), solving 330 of 540 exact-answer math problems versus 328 for the same-size Bonsai 2 Ternary 4B, with lower KL divergence (0.45 vs 0.59 nats). The full recipe and roughly $34 of GPU cost are published under the MIT license.

原文标题：开源量化编译器将 Qwen3.5-4B 压至 1.2 GB

Why it matters：在极小体积下实现优于同尺寸竞品的量化质量，且配方与成本完全公开，对本地部署与端侧推理有直接参考价值。

The new model improves coding from 1,288 to 1,338, rising from #8 to #3, but drops in chat from 1,265 to 1,211, falling from #8 to #11, with the two shifts nearly canceling out in the aggregate score.

item.title: gopgext Lets Developers Build PostgreSQL Extensions in Go
item.description:
Open-source project gopgext uses a custom TinyGo target and runtime layer to compile plain Go code into PostgreSQL extensions, auto-generating C glue, install scripts and control files. It supports the standard library, SQL type mapping, SPI queries and SQLSTATE error codes, but remains experimental and is explicitly not production-ready.

原文标题：gopgext 让 Go 直接编写 PostgreSQL 扩展

Why it matters：为 PostgreSQL 扩展开发引入 Go 生态，思路与 gokm 一脉相承，对数据库与 Go 开发者有实际参考价值。

item.title: Claude Assists Mathematician in Proving Riemann Hypothesis with 17M-Line Lean Proof
item.description:
Anthropic mathematician Alpöge used Claude to prove the Riemann Hypothesis, formalizing the entire argument into roughly 17 million lines of machine-checkable code that Lean's official community certified within a single day. It marks the first time AI has helped crack mathematics' most famous open problem after 167 years, with Claude proposing a key step in areas beyond the human's own expertise.

原文标题：Claude 协助证明黎曼猜想 1700 万行代码获 Lean 社区认证

Why it matters：AI 首次参与攻克数学界最著名的百年难题，且以可机器验证的形式化证明落地，是 AI for Science 的标志性节点。

item.title: NVIDIA Method Caches LLM Reasoning as CPU Code to Cut Costs 291x
item.description:
An NVIDIA paper proposes compiling an LLM's reasoning trace into small parameterized Python functions that run on CPU, invoking a fine-tuned 1B model only for lightweight text tasks such as value extraction. The cache matched or beat the source model on 7 of 8 math and science benchmarks, scoring 93.3% versus 83.3% on AIME '25, and covered at least 90% of rephrased or re-numbered variants at 16x to 291x lower cost.

原文标题：英伟达新方法将推理轨迹缓存为 CPU 代码 成本降 291 倍

Why it matters：把重复推理固化为可执行代码的思路，为智能体高频调用场景提供了可量化的降本路径。

item.title: Lean Proof of Riemann Hypothesis Passes Multi-Kernel Verification
item.description:
Andrew Sutherland of MIT, using Claude Code, has independently verified a Lean formalization of the Riemann Hypothesis: all 175,187 modules compile cleanly, the five headline theorems depend only on the three standard axioms, and two independent kernels, nanoda and con-leche, accept the full exported proof. It marks the first time AI-assisted formal mathematics on a major open problem has reached machine-checkable verification strength.

原文标题：Lean 形式化黎曼猜想证明通过多内核验证

Why it matters：AI 辅助形式化数学首次在黎曼猜想级别难题上通过多内核独立验证，是形式化推理与 AI 工程结合的里程碑事件。

item.title: Zero C# Compiles C# to Native Code Without Runtime or GC
item.description:
Zero C# is a fork of bflat that compiles C# straight into small native programs with no .NET runtime, no garbage collector and nothing to install on the target. It keeps C# syntax, type checking and generics while managing memory through arenas freed all at once, and the same source runs on Linux, macOS, Windows, WebAssembly and even DOS on a 386.

原文标题：Zero C# 让 C# 脱离运行时与 GC 直编原生程序

Why it matters：它展示了 C# 在无运行时、无 GC 约束下的原生编译路径，对系统编程与嵌入式场景具有实际参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI Ships New Prompt Templates for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
item.description:
OpenAI published copy-ready system prompt templates for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to correct behaviors observed in both releases, notably overly brief default answers and unnecessary clarifying questions that interrupt workflows. The templates cover writing style, initiative, and coding, with coding guidance to reuse existing code, avoid needless abstractions, and add tests only on request or for specific errors. API changes accompany the release: editing conversation history discards earlier reasoning steps, affecting token cost and response quality, while parameters such as temperature and top_p are gone.

原文标题：OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 提示词模板

Why it matters：官方提示词模板与 API 行为变更直接影响所有使用 Astra 与 Sol 的开发者，属于可立即落地的工程实践更新。

item.title: SimpleBench Shows Top LLMs Still Trail Ordinary Humans on Common Sense
item.description:
Researchers released SimpleBench, a 200-plus-question multiple-choice benchmark covering spatio-temporal reasoning, social intelligence and linguistic adversarial trick questions. A non-specialized human baseline of 83.7% from nine participants beat every tested frontier model, with top performer Claude Fable reaching only 81.9%, showing memorized knowledge and approximate retrieval are still insufficient for basic common-sense questions.

item.title: Samsung Storage Capacity Through 2029 Largely Sold Out
item.description:

AI data center expansion has driven shortages across HBM, commodity DRAM and enterprise NAND, with major makers meeting only 60% to 70% of demand and 2027 commodity DRAM wafer capacity effectively sold out, strengthening memory vendors' pricing power.

item.title: Thinking Machines 开源 26.4B 循环 Transformer 模型
item.description:
Thinking Machines 发布 Inkling 2 Mini，采用循环 Transformer 架构：仅存储 24 层，中间 12 层以共享权重重复运行 3 次，单 token 实际经过 48 层计算，约 20GB 检查点即可在 32GB Mac 上本地运行。模型总参数 26.4B、激活 3.4B，支持 1M 上下文，以 Apache 2.0 开源，SWE-bench Verified 达 79.2%，DeepSWE 1.1 以 48.2% 超过 Qwen3.8-27B 的 42.2%，但知识召回明显偏弱。

Why it matters：循环层共享权重的小模型以 Apache 2.0 开源并可在消费级设备本地运行，为端侧与低成本推理提供新架构范式。
